verdict.rationale: Slack's first-party docs describe developer sandboxes: Enterprise org environments of two or more workspaces for building against all Slack features "safely and securely" at no extra cost. They are explicitly framed as a way to build "without putting production at risk," which matches the story directly. Missing for 10: details on provisioning or seeding test data and on pointing CLI/MCP/agent tooling at a sandbox, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
